policy: Every exception must have an owner, rationale, mitigation, and an expiry no later than the next Expo SDK upgrade review.

exceptions.summary: ICNS parser denial of service through an infinite loop
exceptions.rationale: This is a transitive Expo/Metro build-tool dependency and is not used to parse untrusted runtime uploads in the Android app.
exceptions.mitigation: The dependency remains locked; runtime document parsing is guarded; CI audit and Expo Doctor run on every release; reassess on Expo SDK upgrade.

exceptions.summary: JXL and HEIF parser denial of service through infinite loops
exceptions.rationale: This is a transitive Expo/Metro build-tool dependency; Ledgr does not expose the affected parser as a server endpoint.
exceptions.mitigation: No production server-side execution depends on the package; lockfile is committed; CI audit and Expo Doctor remain mandatory; reassess on Expo SDK upgrade.

exceptions.summary: Custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero
exceptions.rationale: The advisory is transitive in the Metro/Expo build graph and Ledgr does not pass attacker-controlled zero-size generator arguments.
exceptions.mitigation: Application identifiers use controlled generators; lockfile is committed; CI audit and Expo Doctor run before release; reassess on Expo SDK upgrade.
